europe_now.title: Coordinated School Bomb Threats
europe_now.summary: Educational facilities across Italy, Ireland, and the United Kingdom faced widespread disruptions following a wave of bomb threats. Security investigations remain active across the affected nations as authorities respond to the incidents.

europe_now.title: General Strike in Spain
europe_now.summary: Large-scale protests and a general strike over housing brought out tens of thousands of demonstrators across Spain. Clashes were reported in Barcelona as demonstrators gathered to voice their grievances.

top_stories.title: Regional Security and Diplomacy
top_stories.summary: Delegations from Russia and Ukraine concluded a round of talks while agreeing to implement a significant prisoner exchange. Meanwhile, European leaders convened in Dublin to address ongoing security concerns and hybrid threats.

top_stories.title: Domestic Security and Demonstrations
top_stories.summary: Mass gatherings took place in Poland as tens of thousands of participants attended a nationalist march in Warsaw. Concurrently, public protests and demonstrations related to housing conditions created major disruptions in Spanish cities.
